structure.unit: Powers and Duties of Virginia Lottery Board; Administration of Tickets and Prizes

law.catch_line: Exemption of lottery prizes and sales of tickets from state and local taxation
law.text: Except as provided in Chapter 3 of Title 58.1 and § 58.1-4011, no state or local taxes of any type whatsoever shall be imposed upon any prize awarded or upon the sale of any lottery ticket sold pursuant to the Virginia Lottery Law.
